overview: The first 8-episode installment of this anthology series is set in the 1970s. The psychological thriller tells the harrowing true story of Fred Heckman, a beloved Indianapolis radio reporter who is thrust into the middle of a life-or-death crisis when hostage-taker Tony Kiritsis demands to be interviewed on his popular radio news program.
title: American Hostage

overview: In the first ever season of House Hunters Australia, Aussie buyers dive headfirst into the chaos of finding their dream home and you get to come along for the ride. Narrated by The Project's Georgie Tunny, the stakes are high as buyers tour three homes, each offering a unique mix of pros, cons, and unexpected decisions. Will they fall for the fixer-upper full of potential, the sleek modern gem, or the house they didn't see coming? Whether it's debating modern kitchens versus heritage charm, clashing over pools and veggie patches, or weighing city life against coastal escapes, each episode is packed with big personalities and even bigger decisions. With stunning Australian backdrops, plenty of laughs, and the occasional wild card property that could change everything, every episode delivers the thrill of the hunt and the satisfaction of the final choice. Packed with relatable moments, fiery opinions, and a healthy dose of Aussie humour, play along and guess which home will win their hearts (and wallets).
title: House Hunters Australia

overview: The THERAPY series is unique for its psychological depth, well developed characters and the setting, mostly concentrated in one area. Most of the story takes place in the consulting room of psychologist Marek Posta (Karel Roden) who attends to several patients with a variety of traumas during the weekdays. Every Monday the psychologist receives a saucy Sandra (Tatiana Pauhofová) who confesses in the opening episode that she is in love with Marek.
title: Terapie

overview: Orphan girl A Dai falls for the immortal Xiao Yihan of the righteous Xianling Sect and becomes his disciple. Determined to graduate successfully, A Dai works hard to master all kinds of immortal techniques, while constantly outsmarting and sparring with her teacher and eventually grows into a powerhouse of the sect. However they turns against each other, chasing each other across a thousand miles and locked in a passionate cycle of love and rivalry!
title: Fated Master and Disciple

overview: It tells the story of police officer Qin Feng as he engages in a battle of wits and will with criminal forces. Set against the backdrop of Hanzhou's rapid development, the script draws on a series of serious criminal cases to portray the complex relationships between the police, their families, and powerful interest groups. The main narrative centers on Qin Feng and Liu Tianye, two sworn brothers with no blood ties, exploring the depths of human nature and moral conflict. With a fast-paced plot and constant suspense, the story highlights the struggle between good and evil and the enduring power of faith in the rule of law.
title: The Punishment

overview: One-on-one conversations with politicians and newsmakers, and the breaking issues of the day.
title: The Weeknight

overview: John Green will explore the history and culture of religions and how they offer frameworks for making sense of our lives, while being incredibly slippery things to pin down. We'll discover how we define, debate, and contest what religion means, whether we're personally religious or not.
title: Crash Course Religions

overview: Continuing the story of Pulitzer-prize winning author Alex Haley's ancestors, this award-winning sequel to Roots picks up the story at the conclusion of the Civil War, and covers the significant historic events that impacted Haley and his family, from Reconstruction and Jim Crow, through World War I, the Great Depression, and World War II. The epic account concludes during the Civil Rights movement in the 1960s when the author himself tracks down and eventually meets his distant kin in Gambia, West Africa while preparing to write what would become his ground--breaking novel Roots: The Saga of an American Family.
title: Roots: The Next Generations

overview: Crime Scene Investigators offers a fresh take on the true-crime docudrama, weaving forensic evidence into a single visual frame—a puzzle detectives must piece together to catch the killer. From blood spatter and shell casings to bio-markers and digital fingerprints, every fragment adds to the intricate array of evidence that ultimately exposes a murderer at large.
title: Crime Scene Investigators

overview: Based in Washington, D.C., The Briefing with Jen Psaki will pull from Psaki's decades-long experiences on campaign buses, in the Oval Office, at the State Department, and in the briefing room to dissect the most important stories of the day. Every day the show will aim to help viewers better understand the happenings in Washington and around the country, how it impacts their communities, and what leaders are doing to stand up for the people they represent.
title: The Briefing with Jen Psaki

overview: Based on Wharton's novel of forbidden love in 19th-century New York, The Age of Innocence follows a passionate and heartrending will they, won't they love triangle while exploring themes of freedom, duty, identity, and love in all its forms. The new take promises to be true to Wharton's novel but will speak to a new generation as it traverses the ballrooms and bedrooms of its young characters, asking what is love — and what is lust. And should we ultimately be driven by our heads, or by our hearts?
title: The Age of Innocence

overview: All Rise for Julian Clary as he holds court, presiding over the grievances of the public and acting as judge and jury.
title: All Rise for Julian Clary

overview: Inspired by the internationally beloved bestseller of the same name, Unaccustomed Earth is an epic, soapy drama about a tight-knit immigrant community navigating love, desire, and belonging. When a star-crossed romance between a devoted wife and her long-lost love comes to light, a scandalous affair is born and new battle lines are drawn in the elite, insular Indian American community of Cambridge, Massachusetts. Rich with passion and unforgettable characters, Unaccustomed Earth is an intimate, nuanced look inside a tight-knit community.
title: Unaccustomed Earth

overview: Six sexy singles check into a motel in pursuit of true love, only to discover their longtime booty calls, or "sneaky links," are there as well. Facing desires old and new, and many hard truths, guests must decide whether to strengthen their sneaky link or explore new connections. Will they stay sneaky, or is love worth "checking out"?
title: Sneaky Links: Dating After Dark

overview: As she tries to shine in politics, Mississippi's first Black lieutenant governor must manage her zany family and overcome a boss who's stuck in the past.
title: Miss Governor

overview: The story centers around two journalists who meet at the scene of a brutal serial murder case in Tokyo. The man is a famous freelance writer for a weekly magazine, while the woman is a director for a television information program. As they pursue the same case, the two become attracted to each other, but suspicions about the man begin to emerge one after another.
title: Murderous Encounter

overview: A mummified infant's body is discovered during a renovation in a Frederiksberg apartment. Martha, an 87-year-old resident, unexpectedly confesses to the crime, triggering a journey into family secrets long buried. Crime and mystery intertwines as the complex tale of a family across multiple generations is unfolded. Told through the lens of a crime plot infused with subtle mysterious elements, exploring themes of guilt, shame, and transformation.
title: Generationer

overview: The story of Cha Woo Sol, a victim of school violence for three years, who stabbed the perpetrator in the eye, becoming a criminal from a bullying victim and a world mixed martial arts champion.
title: Shark: The Storm

overview: As science fiction legend Arthur C. Clarke once wrote, any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic. Brought to you through various media and technologies, Daybreak is an interactive story about the magic of technology and its power to transform our lives and aid us in reaching our highest potential.
title: Daybreak
May All Your Wishes Come True

overview: Through a raid on a human trafficking ring, Detective Gu Xinhe and Forensic Artist Qi Chu join Zhao Shi's anti-trafficking task force. As they untangle a web of cold cases, the team zeroes in on the notorious "Auntie Gui" syndicate. Qi Chu goes undercover at great personal risk, leading to the takedown of the long-operating criminal network and exposing Auntie Gui's horrifying scheme of "using trafficking to fund more trafficking.
title: The Long Way Home

overview: Three female roommates with entirely different careers, personalities, and schedules share a home. Despite their differences, they share one ritual. No matter what conflicts or problems they face in life, love, or work, they always come together as night falls to cook and share a proper meal. For them, the day's troubles always seem to resolve themselves after dinner.
title: The Corner of the World is Dinner

overview: The demon princess Zhao Yue, who had originally only set revenge as her goal, found herself entangled in an unexpected scandal on her wedding day. The river god Ruo Xiao crashed the ceremony, bringing along a child. Before anyone could react, Zhao Yue's fiancé, the demon lord, flew into a rage over being "cuckolded," unleashing a thunderstorm and throwing knives at his bride. Zhao Yue was utterly baffled, unable to understand why the ancient god would barge into her wedding with a child, and she firmly denied any connection to either Ruo Xiao or the child. However, wary of the complications involving a child, she quickly assessed the situation and decided to "flee with the child" for now. During the escape, memories of a long-sealed past slowly resurfaced. Beneath the absurd chaos lay a deep and enduring love that had remained unresolved for a hundred years. It turns out that years ago, by the cold waters of Qingying Pool, the ancient god Ruo Xiao, moved by compassion, had fallen for a wounded demon woman who had descended from the sky. However, he gave his body and mind to the wrong person and ended up raising a child alone for five hundred years, waiting for his wife to return. As the truth comes to light and their love reignites, they must face an impossible choice. On one side, the love is too deep to suppress, and on the other side, the gods and demons are on different paths. How will they decide their fate?
title: A Promise to You

overview: Step into a world where sparks fly and hearts race as everyone is introduced at a masquerade ball to connect, flirt, and find romance. But it's not just about finding someone new—some of these singles have a history! Will old flames reignite? As jealousy bubbles up faster than the hot tub jets during a hot-tub-speed-dating session, tensions rise, and feelings get messy. From flirty first impressions to late-night confessions, expect shocking hook-ups and unexpected pairings. The journey transforms into a thrilling adventure in chemistry and connection, filled with romantic curveballs and twists for each of the singles.
title: 90 Day: Hunt for Love

overview: Cardiac Arrest is a British medical drama series made by World Productions for BBC1 and first broadcast between 1994 and 1996. The series was controversial due to its cynical depiction of doctors, nurses, and the National Health Service, although it has often topped polls of the UK medical profession as the most realistic medical drama of all time. The series was created by Jed Mercurio (writing under the pseudonym John MacUre), a former junior doctor who had worked at a hospital in Wolverhampton, who drew on his own personal experiences to provide a more visceral, albeit wryly humorous, look at the NHS in the 1990s. Cardiac Arrest is a satirical comedy drama that follows the journey of Dr. Andrew Collin, a newly qualified houseman who arrives on the wards equipped only with theoretical knowledge and a sense of humour. Collin's idealism is immediately at odds with senior house officer Claire Maitland, a pragmatic and cynical physician determined to make him learn the hard way.
title: Cardiac Arrest

overview: MKR favourites Manu Feildel and Colin Fassnidge are going Off The Grid on a road trip around Aotearoa to discover local places, local faces, and local produce - with a generous dose of banter for good measure!
title: Off the Grid with Colin and Manu

overview: Deep Look explores the unseen at the very edge of our visible world. Get a new perspective on our place in the universe and meet extraordinary new friends. Explore big scientific mysteries by going incredibly small.
title: Deep Look

overview: This unfiltered, one-hour after-show dives deeper into each week's episodes. Cast members from this season will provide behind-the-scenes commentary and personal reflections on their heated romances in Tulum. Through never-before-seen footage, viewers will get an exclusive insider look at what really went down, both on and off camera, in paradise.
title: Hunt for Love: Between the Sheets

overview: Hot on the heels of the Irish Dancing World Championships in Dublin this month, Sky is today announcing a brand-new series charting the drama and devotion of Ireland's most loved artform. New Sky Original, Battle of the Irish Dancers, coming later this year, follows a cast of dedicated dancers and their teachers on the road to the Championships, spotlighting a dance form which requires the strength, endurance and agility of an Olympian.
title: Battle of the Irish Dancers

overview: From Whitehorse to the remote towns at the edge of the Arctic, the Yukon is one of the most challenging places on Earth to live... let alone be a first responder. But someone has to do the job. Yukon Rescue is a heart-pounding doc series about the Yukoners who answer the call to keep people safe in the rugged Canadian North. Featuring breaking cases from wildfire to search and rescue, animal services to highways, these front line workers go toe-to-toe with Mother Nature - battling lethal temperatures, vast distances, scarce supplies, and an unforgiving landscape to get the job done.
title: Yukon Rescue

overview: In the first three seasons, as Dr. Paul Weston continues to struggle with the aftermath of his divorce, he faces new emotional and physical challenges - including hand tremors that he fears might be the onset of Parkinson's Disease, which killed his father. Meanwhile, he takes on three challenging new patients and turns to a new therapist of his own. In fourth season, the reimagining of the series is set in 2021 Los Angeles and brings a diverse trio of patients in session with the observant, empathetic Dr. Brooke Taylor to help navigate a variety of modern concerns. Issues such as the global pandemic and recent major social and cultural shifts are a backdrop to the work Brooke will undertake – all while she deals with complications in her own personal life.
title: In Treatment

overview: Specially filmed for BBC Three as a companion piece to Doctor Who, Doctor Who Confidential aims to give a taste of the excitement and the energy that surrounds the show. The programme includes behind-the-scenes filming and interviews with the cast, writers and production team as they bring our favourite Time Lord back to our screens.
title: Doctor Who Confidential

overview: An absurdist comedy show. Oiginal for its time, it represented a renewal of comedy on Argentine television.
title: De la cabeza

overview: No facts, no figures, no records broken. In this new musical diversion, the sounds of today echo back nostalgically from a loophole in time. The programme features the words, music and performance of Neil Innes with special contributions from guest stars.
title: The Innes Book of Records

overview: Genius traditional Chinese painter Xin Yi returns to her picturesque hometown with a hidden agenda. She carefully lays out a plan to become the hired artist of renowned collector Guan Shanhai. But her true motive is to uncover the truth behind a horrific incident from over a decade ago - her father was lured into a counterfeit art factory and died tragically, while her younger sister Nong was brutally abused and left mentally shattered. Using herself as bait, Xin Yi is determined to expose the mastermind behind the tragedy. At a critical moment, Guan Shanhai's son, Guan Huai, unexpectedly offers her a helping hand—hoping to use her in his own power struggle to usurp control from his father. With hidden intentions on both sides, the two begin a perilous collaboration, stirring up a storm in what once was a quiet and peaceful town…
title: Loving the Lie

overview: In the first year of the Zaichu era, Tang Dynasty, a bizarre suicide resembling a ghost-summoning ritual shocks Yuezhou's West District. Investigating the case, Si Wen, the young magistrate of Yue Prefecture, discovers the victim is none other than Liu Zhaodi, a once-renowned courtesan he once loved deeply. But as the seventh day of her death arrives, abandoned infants rise as vengeful mountain spirits, unraveling a meticulously planned retribution...
title: Yuezhou Phantom Tales

overview: The Art Assignment is an educational video series hosted by curator Sarah Urist Green. We explore art and art history through the lens of things happening today.
title: The Art Assignment

overview: Two Cents is an educational show about personal finance.
title: Two Cents

overview: The Gradys, a Midwestern family, inherit a bayfront California hotel. Mickey Rooney stars as Mickey Grady, a lifelong landlocked Nebraskan who sees the Pacific Ocean for the first time when he and his family drive out to look over the bay-front hotel he inherited. Sammee Tong plays the hotel manager who was included in the inheritance. Emmaline Henry plays Mickey's wife; real-life son Tim Rooney and Brian Nash, the sons.
title: Mickey

overview: Teen Wolf: Search for a Cure stars Scott and his best friend Stiles star in the web series, which takes the audience deeper into the search for the werewolf curse while also introducing viewers to a new character, Dr. Fenris. The webisodes will serve as a companion to the television series.
title: Teen Wolf: Search for a Cure

overview: Every aspect of our daily reality, whether its the words we use, the pop culture we love, the technology that get us through the day, or even the identities we give ourselves, emerge from thousands of intersecting histories. And on this show, we're going to explore them ALL! . . . Okay, maybe not ALL, but you get the idea.
title: Origin of Everything

overview: What is our society's relationship to death? Many are disconnected from its reality and afraid to even think of it or discuss it. How did we get here, and are there different ways to connect to this part of life that we all must face for ourselves and our loved ones? How do we reclaim death from the industries and processes that have distanced us from it?
title: Dead and Buried

overview: Being a human can be weird. Even when everything is "normal" (whatever that means), you might not always get what your body is doing…or why. Dr. Tina Lasisi, full-time biological anthropologist and part-time human, is here to help you make sense of how and why our bodies do what they do.
title: Why Am I Like This?

overview: Vanessa Hill talks about psychology, neuroscience, and why we act the way we do. Neuroscience has never been so animated.
title: BrainCraft

overview: Have you ever looked around and wondered how society transformed into what it is today? Felecia For the Win is here to shed some light on it all. On Roots of Resistance we'll take a deep dive into various social movements, and into the individuals who helped create them, that have shaped how we exist today.
title: Roots of Resistance

overview: A fictional tale following the rise of five ambitious secretaries navigating the glitzy world of 1980s Hollywood while offering a glimpse into the boys-will-be-boys club and the women who wanted a seat at a table where they were expected to serve. It's a juicy story of friendship, betrayal, survival and ambition. It's also a cautionary tale about how some of those women became very much like the monsters they worked for.
title: Climbing in Heels

overview: After the tragic death of her parents, Mila inherits a huge debt. A chance to save herself is a dance competition with a million-dollar prize. But there is little time to prepare: collectors demand immediate payment. Will Mila manage to win and avoid the debt hole?
title: Кредит доверия

overview: The protagonist, Fushigi Mai, who works at the silent cafe "Morning Glory," and her colleague at the cafe, Kamishita Ryo, a younger man who has a close relationship with people, one day enter into a relationship where they "observe" each other. While working together, Mai becomes interested in Ryo, but it's not easy because she has a trauma from her first love and is in a complicated relationship... Meanwhile, Ryo is also interested in Mai, and behind his cool appearance, his feelings for Mai overflow... Will the two be able to open the door to each other's hearts?
title: Yabusaka de wa Gozaimasen

overview: John Campbell has spent months investigating Destiny Church, encountering fear from insiders like he's never seen before—what is Brian Tamaki doing, and why does it terrify them?
title: Under His Command

overview: Esmeralda, whom everybody calls "The Stray Cat", grew up in a suburban slum under miserable conditions; ever since she was a little girl she has lived with Doña Rita, who exploits her by sending her out on the streets to beg or sell candies in order to "earn her food and bed". As a child, she became friends with Pablo, a wealthy child who cares for her and tries to help her behind his mother´s back, Lorenza, who looks down on "The Stray Cat" due to her social prejudices which make her reject poor, uneducated people. Esmeralda has turned into a beautiful woman over time and although she is still very poor, she has managed to always look pretty in front of Pablo. They have grown together, but Pablo has problems with noticing that he feels more than just affection for her.
title: La Gata

overview: Julian is an engineer who overnight destroys his life, his marriage, and his work, as he is blamed for a murder he did not commit. After being sentenced to 26 years in prison, he decides to run away to find the only witness who knows the real culprit.
title: Fugitivos

overview: In the bigoted and retrograde Palermo of the immediate post-war period, Letizia is a curious and rebellious girl who at sixteen decides to get married hoping to have more freedom but instead finds herself trapped in a marriage strictly disciplined by patriarchal rules. Following a nervous breakdown, she will be admitted to a Swiss clinic and undergo psychiatric treatment. Back in Palermo, with her marriage in full crisis and in a state of perennial emotional fragility, Letizia decides to face her malaise with psychoanalysis, continuing to feel trapped in a reality that she cannot accept.
title: Solo per passione - Letizia Battaglia fotografa

overview: Recently discovered police recordings and first-person accounts tell the story of Fred and Rose West, two of the UK's most prolific murderers.
title: Fred & Rose West: A British Horror Story

overview: 11 celebrity couples are each given a suitcase. One contains half a million, another sends you home. Welcome to Hotellet!
title: Hotellet

overview: Nicolai Tangen and his team's job is to make our savings grow. How do they work to succeed in that?
title: Oljefondet - på innsiden

overview: This is the story of Zhenya, a young woman who, having come to Moscow from the provinces and begun working with Russian stars, becomes familiar with the customs and traditions of show business. Despite all her adventures, she remains true to herself, and that's precisely why she achieves recognition and finds love.
title: Любовь – не шоу-бизнес

overview: Sisters Ylva-li and Ronja grew up in the dog farm and train dog sleds together. The goal is to become the first Norwegian juniors to participate in the Iditarod.
title: Drømmen om Alaska

overview: Doctor Who Extra brings you unprecedented access to the making of Doctor Who... Featuring interviews with Peter Capaldi and Jenna Coleman, it's the ultimate backstage pass!
title: Doctor Who Extra

overview: "Keys to the Truth" is a gripping detective series where every secret hides a deep personal drama. Valeria, a seasoned investigator, is forced to leave the service after the tragic death of her brother, who was wrongly accused of a crime. Losing faith in the system, she launches her own investigation, which leads her to a luxurious hotel hiding dark intrigues, lies, and crimes behind its elegant walls. The path to truth proves to be more dangerous than she ever expected. She's not just searching for the culprit — she's fighting for the truth that could change everything.
title: Ключі від правди

overview: It's Lit! is a series of smart, funny video essays about our favorite books and why we love to read. Hosted by Lindsay Ellis and Princess Weekes, the series delves into topics like the evolution of YA, how science fiction mirrors our own anxieties, and why the book is sometimes just a _bit_ better than the movie.
title: It's Lit!

overview: Entomologist and museum curator Jessica Ware will introduce us to insects that upend our expectations and a diverse group of scientists who are passionate about the six-legged critters all around us. Forget about pandas–we're here to make you fall in love with mandibles! The series is produced for PBS by the American Museum of Natural History.
title: Insectarium

overview: Mathematician Kelsey Houston-Edwards offers ambitious content for viewers that are eager to attain a greater understanding of the world around them. Math is pervasive - a robust yet precise language - and with each episode you'll begin to see the math that underpins everything in this puzzling, yet fascinating, universe.
title: Infinite Series

overview: Investigator Veronika Levchenko is forced to cooperate with the talented cybercriminal Andriy Miroshnyk in order to save her younger brother. Veronika and Andrii fall in love with each other, but realize that they cannot be together. Can their love overcome the boundaries of duty and danger?
title: Код кохання

overview: Discover how Indigenous innovation and technology allows Indigenous communities to survive and thrive now and across the centuries. Our host, Cheyenne Bearfoot, will explore various native and Indigenous identities across the globe in order to unravel stereotypes that have diminished innovations made by Indigenous peoples.
title: Sovereign Innovations

overview: Discovering the real stories of the medieval knights who dedicated their entire lives to God, the Crusaders, to delve deeper into the history behind the popular image of heroic, chivalrous knights.
title: The Crusaders

overview: Sri Lanka is one of the most bio-diverse places on the planet but it's also home to one of the world's fastest-growing human populations. Animals and humans come into increasing contact and the results can be catastrophic. In this three part series we meet the scientists and researchers who are dedicating their lives to ensuring that Sri Lanka's most extraordinary wildlife – elephants, monkeys and sloth bears – can share this tiny island with people in peace.
title: Wild Crusades

overview: The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole, Aged 13¾ is a British television series based on the book of the same name written by Sue Townsend. It started in 1985 and starred Gian Sammarco, as the title character Adrian Mole, Stephen Moore as Adrian's father George Mole and Julie Walters as Adrian's mother Pauline Mole.
title: The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole, Aged 13¾

overview: Serving Up Science is hosted by history buff, science writer and foodie Sheril Kirshenbaum, who will give you science-backed tips to make your favorite foods even better. Farmed or Wild? Why does cheese stink? Why should meat rest? Explore these questions and more.
title: Serving Up Science

overview: In the bustling streets and among the common folk, strange and eerie phenomena arise. Humans, demons, deities, and spirits all understand the ways of the world, while flowers, trees, birds, and beasts are all imbued with a certain spirit. Humans have a touch of the demonic, and demons possess a human heart. This revival of classic Eastern supernatural tales, with a volume of "Liao Zhai," discerns the good and evil between yin and yang, and paints a vivid picture of the myriad aspects of life.
title: Liao Zhai

overview: The series shows the richest people in the world who have great influence in their countries: In China and Russia they live dangerously, in the USA they are changing the modern world with innovations.
title: Tycoons - Die Macht der Milliardäre

overview: Hamish McLaren scammed friends, lovers and acquaintances out of over $60 million. This is the shocking story of Australia's most successful con artist. Part of True Crime on Channel 4.
title: The Sixty Million Dollar Conman

overview: A fierce warrior-class emerges in medieval Europe around 1000 years ago: the knights. They live brutal lives, glorified by tales of chivalry and courtly love that have left us with a skewed idea of knighthood. In reality, it's a world of freezing castles and violent battles, where joust competitions, fair maidens and the crusades are the latest fads. Manners and gallantry are everything and their abuse can end in deadly duels. This elegant and exciting 3-part series evokes the time of the knights in a unique and intimate rollercoaster ride of individual lives set in the wider context of medieval Europe. Their stories are told in gripping reenactments, illustrated by stunning CGI and explored with engaging documentary sequences.
title: Welt der Ritter

overview: Revealing how the monarchy uses traditions to maintain a place in our nation's identity.
title: Secrets of the Royal Traditions

overview: Building contractor and all-around handyman Bob Vila visits the sites of various home and commercial building construction and restorations, and gives viewers tips on the best way to finish such projects.
title: Bob Vila's Home Again

overview: An ordinary hairdresser Irina, having separated from her husband, is raising her daughter Masha alone. Unexpectedly, fate gives Irina a gift: meeting a successful businessman Oleg Tsarev. Trying to please him, Irina comes up with a new successful life for herself, in which she is the owner of an elite beauty salon, and her daughter is a student at a private school. Irina and Oleg's relationship is moving towards the registry office, but suddenly her husband Kolya, whom she has not officially divorced, appears on the threshold of Irina's apartment. Kolya is determined to get his family and Irina's love back.
title: Снежный папа

overview: A series dedicated to the centenary of Irish writer Sean O'Casey consisting of a documentary on his life followed by three dramatisations of his plays.
title: A Celebration of Sean O'Casey

overview: Lured by promises of a better life, three young women are sold into prostitution and must risk their lives and their families to escape.
title: La Promesa

overview: This is the story of two characters, a witch and a known mafia boss, who strongly influence Colombia's political destiny at the end of the 1970s, changing the entire future of the country.
title: La Bruja
